description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Title', which is used for creating and displaying a title in a graphical image. It includes methods for setting the text, font, alignment, and rendering the title within a graphical layout.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Title
classes.description: Main class for creating and rendering a title within a graph layout.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Title
methods.description: Constructor for setting the title text and font options.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the title text to be displayed.

methods.name: _getAutoSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the automatic size of the title based on font and text height.

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: Sets the alignment of the title (left, center, right).

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the title on the canvas, positioning it according to parent layout.
